title: Hawkins: medical assurances and institutional questions
shortTitle: Hawkins: medical assurances and institutional questions
summary: The notes ask when assurances in medical treatment should receive contract consequences.
notes: An estimate, a guarantee, and reassurance can be different speech acts even when they concern the same operation. The later procedural question asks which determinations belong to judge and jury. References to medical-promise writing rules and other cases are dated source comparisons. Do not silently replace the assigned guarantee theory with the professional negligence standard.
